metadata.case_name: NG CHUNG WING ALEXANDER, JR v. SIU PIK PU AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: driver both of his employer's car and of a truck

injuries.description: the facial injuries had resulted in a continuous circular scar some two inches in diameter by the left corner of the Plaintiff's mouth.
injuries.body_part: left corner of the Plaintiff's mouth
source: After nine months the Plaintiff was examined by Dr Wedderburn who, apart from an infection of the gum and certain teeth, found that the facial injuries had resulted in a continuous circular scar some two inches in diameter by the left corner of the Plaintiff's mouth.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of lip or oral cavity

injuries.description: division of the end nerve fibres running to the orbicularis oris which is semi-paralysed on the left side
injuries.body_part: orbicularis oris (circular muscle around the mouth) on the left side
source: "This is due to a division of the end nerve fibres running to the orbicularis oris which is semi-paralysed on the left side.

manifestations.description: On opening his mouth the left side is pulled upwards in a marked manner as compared to the right and the left corner of the mouth also moves upwards in a very distinct difference from the right side of the mouth when he smiles or grimaces.
This is due to a paralysis of the circular muscle around the mouth, the orbicularis oris, on the left side.
He tends to dribble food from the left corner of the mouth when eating and at night his pillow tends to be soaked with saliva.
He is embarrassed at social gatherings and feels people stare at him.

treatments_future: cosmetic surgery to improve scar (advised by Dr Raymond Wang)

losses.description: the Plaintiff's face carries a disfiguring scar of a distinctive shape
paralysis of the circular muscle around the mouth, the orbicularis oris, on the left side causing dribbling of food from the left corner of the mouth when eating
He is embarrassed at social gatherings and feels people stare at him.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chen Shueh Chen v Tam Wai Chon
